provenance.method: NECB 2025 Table 6.2.2.1 retrieved in full via the building-codes MCP and compared to 2020: every formula this gem implements is IDENTICAL (electric SL formulas, all gas UEF ladder coefficients, Et>=90%+SL large-equipment row, oil rows, solar/pool rows). The ONLY substantive 2025 change is the storage-type heat-pump water heater requirement: EF >= 2.1 -> UEF >= 2.23 (an equipment class this gem does not model — recorded below). 2025 therefore shares the 2020 algorithm parameters.
provenance.reference_article: 8.4.5.20: reference SWH identical to proposed (storage capacity, power input, energy type); HP-source SWH -> air-source HP. Sentences (3)-(4) were machine-verified against the full article text (D-41) and are satisfied by clone; Part 6 minimums apply on top. part_load_curve.name: SWH-EFFFPLR-NECB2011
part_load_curve.derivation: 8.4.6.9.(2) writes a FUEL-RATIO curve: FHeatPLC = a + b(Qpl/Qdes) + c(Qpl/Qdes)^2, with Fuelpartload = Fueldesign x FHeatPLC. The EnergyPlus WaterHeater:Mixed 'Part Load Factor Curve Name' field is not that quantity — it is a DEGRADATION DIVISOR (fuel = Q_load / (eta x PLF)). The code curve therefore maps into the model field as PLF(x) = x / FHeatPLC(x), which is RATIONAL, not polynomial; the vendored cubic is its polynomial image and is probe-verified equivalent (max 0.98% over PLR 0.25-1.0, 1.47% down to PLR 0.10 — necb_8_4_6_curve_probe.rb, rake necb:curves). Vendoring the raw quadratic in the PLF field would invert the relation and overstate part-load fuel by +92% at half load and +253% at quarter load, and would double-count the a-term standby that E+ already carries as off-cycle parasitic fuel + tank UA. See D-53. The NECB2011-era NAME is retained deliberately for the legacy parity gate.
part_load_curve.applies_to_note: Fuel-fired only, and BOTH storage and instantaneous: the article is titled 'Fuel-Fired Service Water Heater' and governs 'the reference fuel-fired service water heater' without distinguishing storage from instantaneous. Electricity is outside the article's scope (D-53), not a silent skip.

articles.title: Service water heater performance (Table 6.2.2.1)
articles.how: electric storage (SL formulas), gas-fired storage (UEF ladders + Et>=90%/SL for large) and oil (via the gas path, legacy behavior) implemented on WaterHeaterMixed with Maguire-Roberts UA derivation; instantaneous rows (gas UEF 0.86 conservative / Et 0.94, oil Et 0.80, tankless zero UA) and storage heat-pump water heaters (WaterHeaterHeatPump build + code EF/UEF floor as rated COP) implemented
articles.gaps: pool-heater minimums IMPLEMENTED apply-when-present since D-63 (gas Et 82% / oil 78% / HP COP 4.0 floor set on heaters serving a SwimmingPoolIndoor; values from the printed rows hbix's table audit recovered — the extraction LOST the solar/pool sections in both editions and the Volume of Tank column in all 27 rows, so the D-41 MCP cross-check could not see them; volume-binned values stand on their legacy-primary transcription). Solar-thermal SEF (>= 1.4 electric-aux / >= 0.9 gas-aux) is an equipment RATING with no EnergyPlus field: detected collectors get an audited determination, the physics stay cloned. No archetype exercises either class. HPWH uses the bounded pumped-condenser construction (upstream stratified-tank/EMS recipe not ported)

articles.title: Remaining reference SWH sentences (2025 renumbered performance path)
articles.how: (3)/(4) verified against the full article text (retrieved via MCP 2026-07-28 after the ingestion fix): the umbrella's clone preserves the boiler-fed immersion coil's energy type ((3)) and the multi-energy capacity allocation and operating schedules identically — trivially matching the (4)(a) ratio (Note A-8.4.5.20.(4)(a) merely says how to determine it) and (4)(b) operational characteristics. Part 6 minimum efficiencies applied on top via apply_efficiency. (5) the 8.4.6.9.(2) FHeatPLC fuel part-load curve is applied to every fuel-fired reference water heater, storage AND instantaneous, via the documented PLF(x) = x / FHeatPLC(x) transform into the EnergyPlus part-load-factor field (probe-verified equivalent, max 0.98% over PLR 0.25-1.0; D-53). Electric water heaters carry NO such curve BY ARTICLE SCOPE, not by omission: 8.4.6.9 is titled 'Fuel-Fired Service Water Heater' and governs only the reference fuel-fired heater — there is no electric counterpart in 8.4.6 to apply.
articles.gaps: REFINED after machine-verification (D-41) and D-53: (3)/(4)/(6)/(7)/(8) are satisfied by clone and (5) is closed for every article-eligible heater. Remaining: (9) circulation-pump consolidation is satisfied BY CONSTRUCTION for models this gem authors — necb/demand.rb builds exactly ONE PumpConstantSpeed per service water loop, so there is never a set of pumps to consolidate. It is unverified only for a FOREIGN proposed that arrives with several pumps on one SHW loop; such a model is cloned as-is, keeping identical W/(L/s) (energy-equivalent, topology differs). No consolidation pass is implemented because it would be unreachable code on every model this toolchain produces.
